questions.question: What do the "melting pot" and "salad bowl" metaphors describe?
options: Two models of diversity: blending into one culture versus keeping distinct cultures side by side
questions.explanation: The melting pot describes assimilation into one shared culture; the salad bowl describes distinct cultures coexisting.

questions.question: What does the history of Irish Americans "becoming white" illustrate?
options: That race is a social construction that can change over time
questions.explanation: Irish immigrants were once seen as racially inferior but were later included in the majority — showing race is socially constructed.

questions.question: Which statement about US demographics (2023) is correct?
options: Hispanic/Latino Americans make up roughly 19% of the population
Asian Americans are the largest group
questions.explanation: Roughly: White ~58%, Hispanic/Latino ~19%, Black ~13%, Asian ~6%, Native American ~1%.

questions.question: What does "E Pluribus Unum" mean?
questions.explanation: The national motto "E Pluribus Unum" means "From many, one" — unity from diversity.

questions.question: Which factors helped Irish and Italian immigrants become part of the American mainstream?
options: Economic success, moving to suburbs, intermarriage and inclusion in government programs
A Supreme Court ruling in their favour
questions.explanation: Economic mobility, suburbanisation, intermarriage and programs like the GI Bill helped these groups join the majority.
